Name: Feature
Description: Adds, adjusts or removes a feature to/of/from the API or UI

Name: Bug Fix
Description: Fixes an API or UI bug of a preceded feat commit

Name: Refactor
Description: Rewrites or restructures code without altering API or UI behavior

Name: Performance
Description: A special kind of refactor that specifically improves performance

Name: Style
Description: Code style changes (whitespace, formatting, missing semicolons) that do not affect behavior

Name: Test
Description: Adds missing tests or corrects existing ones

Name: Build
Description: Changes to build tools, dependencies, project version, etc.

Name: CI
Description: Changes to CI configuration files and scripts (e.g. GitHub Actions workflows)

Name: Chore
Description: Maintenance tasks like modifying .gitignore or the initial commit
